name: tenants_add_exchange_rate
description: Add an exchange rate: one unit of from_currency is worth rate units of to_currency from applies_from (YYYY-MM-DD) until a later rate for the pair applies. Both are ISO 4217 codes. One rate per pair and date, either way round; use tenants_change_exchange_rate to correct one. A rate is a decimal string above zero with at most twelve decimal places, such as "0.92": one unit of from_currency is worth that much to_currency. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.
